lede: A crown, a portrait and a simple message: B-POP Tags celebrates Blackzang, the king who redefined Bangladeshi hip hop.
body:
Some tributes don't need many words. B-POP Tags celebrated [@blackzang_bz](https://www.instagram.com/blackzang_bz/) as "the king" of **Bangladeshi hip hop**, the artist "who redefined the hip hop scene in Bangladesh and took it to global heights."

## Blackzang and the rise of Bangladeshi hip hop

The caption speaks of celebrating and enjoying "the grace of the king", and closes with two words: "Love and Prayers." Its hashtags, #hiphopbangladesh, #hiphopnation, #bangladeshi and #blackzang, frame the post as a salute from the wider scene, and a reminder of how much of today's Bangla rap owes to the artists who came first.

## The cover

The graphic matches the message. A portrait of Blackzang in sunglasses and a shearling-collared jacket sits against a pop-art backdrop of blue and yellow stars, with a gold, spray-painted crown drawn above his head.

## Keep listening

Hip hop is one of the threads running through [Music & Rave](topic:music). For the newer generation, read about [Mass $cott and the sound of modern Bangla trap](post:mass-scott-modern-bangla-trap). For other artists lifting Bangladesh's profile abroad, see [Halfcian of Salted Jus](post:halfcian-salted-jus-bangladesh-global-music) and the label story of [Qinetic Music](post:qinetic-music-bengali-pop-label). More on the [B-POP Tags home page](home:).
